from.description: The first UTC day of the range (inclusive).

to.description: The last UTC day of the range (inclusive).

days.description: One row per UTC day that has any fact, ordered by day.

received_eaches.description: The eaches of every received line of the day, not only of the listed items.

received_item_count.description: The distinct GTINs received that day, not only the listed ones.

received_by_item.description: At most 10 items, most eaches first, ties by GTIN.

gtin.description: The EACH-level GTIN when the receipt resolved it, otherwise the carton GTIN (ADR 0014).

catalog_item_id.description: Present when a received line of that day resolved the catalogue item.

publications.description: The receipts of the day that listed this GTIN.

advisory_to_receipt_samples.description: The received lines of the day that had a preceding placement advisory of the same seller and item.

advisory_to_receipt_p50_seconds.description: Median seconds from that advisory to the receipt; null without a sample.

advisory_to_receipt_p95_seconds.description: 95th-percentile seconds from that advisory to the receipt; null without a sample.
